context: Some rules are a priori infinitary, but in some cases (such as the one considered in [6]) it is possible to present the rules in a finitary way. This formal system expresses the laws of cubical cwfs in rule form. It defines the term model. Following [29, 24] developed in an intuitionistic framework, we conjecture that this can be interpreted in an arbitrary cubical cwf in the usual way: I Conjecture 2. With chosen parameters C, I, F, the cubical cwf T is initial in the category of cubical cwfs. However, our canonicity result is orthogonal to this conjecture: It is a result about the initial model, without need for an explicit description of this model as a term model.
